title: mammillaria haageana subsp. vaupelii
intro: Mammillaria haageana subsp. vaupelii, commonly known as the Vaupel's Pincushion Cactus, is a species of cactus in the genus Mammillaria. This plant is known for its small, globular shape and short, fine spines, with white flowers that bloom in the spring. Mammillaria haageana subsp. vaupelii has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to exert therapeutic actions including antimicrobial and anti-cancer properties.
